title: Rethinking dementia prevention for a continuum of risk
title_zh: 重新思考一系列风险下的痴呆预防
abstract: Multiple modifiable risk factors for dementia commonly co-occur in a large proportion of the population, challenging the distinction between individuals at high risk and the wider population. Dementia prevention should therefore move beyond binary eligibility towards a combination of population-wide prevention and intensive interventions that reflect the continuum of risk.
abstract_zh: 痴呆的多个可改变风险因素在大量人群中常共同出现，这挑战了高危人群与广大人群的界限。因此，痴呆预防应超越二元的资格标准，转向结合人群-wide预防和强化干预，以反映风险的连续性。
